BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Serialized data comes from a remote request.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Crafted payloads for common Node.js deserializers are publicly documented.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The vulnerable endpoint is reachable without authentication.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The attacker sends the payload directly; no victim action is needed.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Gadget execution happens inside the same Node.js process.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Code execution through deserialization exposes all process data.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Code execution through deserialization allows arbitrary modification.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Malicious objects can crash the process or exhaust memory.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
